automation_verification_source: Root created, updated and peeked both enabled tasks in this exact conversation; setup proof is separate from future run completion.

pending.required_disposition: Re-read exact run_id+attempt+head, record actual conclusion; no other-owner dispatch/write. CI completion alone does not close A-G3; independent owner review/governance/G7/GIE still required.

lease.reason: Actual archived replay uses another checkout and writes inside repository; portable source-pinned replay and malformed packet diagnostic repair

publication.update_after_publish: Only after remote HEAD/file bytes and output hashes are verified. STATE.json itself is excluded from output fingerprint; current commit identity cannot be self-embedded.
publication.coordination_head_note: State release containing this receipt is resolved from current PR/Git metadata, not self-embedded.

self_update_filter.edited_own_comments: Read semantic change; retained ID/marker alone never suppresses modified content.

fingerprint_policy.include: Relevant fresh dependency source/head/authority/decision changes, relevant comment or review revisions, scoped owner source inputs, and pending exact-subject CI state.; Global-only Chart-relevant source/decision/receipt blob fingerprints independently of PR HEAD. Ignore unrelated Global/index clocks.
fingerprint_policy.output_exclusion: Mutable lease timestamps and state commit identity do not create a work delta by themselves.
fingerprint_policy.no_op: No semantic delta and no actionable pending item means no lease acquisition, no state/commit/comment/PR write.

atomic_protocol.required_remote_operation: Fresh owner HEAD→commit whose only parent is that HEAD→non-force fast-forward update_ref→verify exact remote SHA and lease run_id/expiry.
atomic_protocol.compare_and_swap_condition: If competing divergent commit moves owner ref, update_ref fails; do not force or automatically rebase lease/output onto the winner. Re-read and remain read-only.
atomic_protocol.renewal: While unexpired, fresh-read remote state and verify same run_id before publishing renewal with new parent/current HEAD and same-holder expiry.
atomic_protocol.expiry: Expired or mismatching run_id prevents every mutation; fresh evaluation and a new verified atomic acquisition are required.
atomic_protocol.missing_atomic_capability: Read-only audit is allowed; every write must be abstained from.

workflow_rule: Reuse prior audit/history. Process only a real bounded material delta or actionable pending CI; decisions/readiness never advance from scheduling alone.

automation_delivery_observed.self_event_processing: No duplicate production/evidence work; live manual lease and narrow attribution preserved.

approval_pins.explicit_user_scope: 2026-10-05 latest Chart continuation through success within Chart-owned scope; no canonical merge/Frozen/Holdout/PIT/Official or other-owner writes
approval_pins.production_continuation: All6actual owner gates close -> implement approved exact write-set through deterministic validation/E2E/required actual-result FPIA/handoff autonomously. Protected production/new policy/canonical/Frozen/PIT/Official and other explicit current scoped D3 boundaries need actual approval; wider previous Global delegation cannot override later explicit Chart boundary.

automation_conversation_discrepancy: Actual tool conversation IDs differ from v0.5 setup conversation ID; IDs/enabled state fresh verified; tasks not moved/recreated.

execution_policy.independent_d1_d2_completion: Diagnostic implementation/verification/evidence/handoff proceeds while owner CI/input dependencies remain

lease.release_responsibility: Root releases after successful publication and verification; active local initialization alone is not a verified remote lease.
lease.reason: Current user authorizes durable Global-only dependency intake and automatic approved-write-set production continuation; renewal before expiry

automation_audit.historical_global_intake: PR-only coverage limit now addressed by enabled hourly Global-aware Main
